message.name: MeetingInstructionV11
message.definition: Scope|The MeetingInstruction message is sent by a party holding the right to vote to an intermediary, the issuer or its agent to request the receiving party to act upon one or several instructions.|Usage|The MeetingInstruction message is used to vote, to require attendance to a meeting, to request registration of securities, and assign a proxy. One instruction or multiple instructions can be carried within the same message.|Once the message is sent, it cannot be modified. It must be cancelled by a MeetingInstructionCancellationRequest. Only after receipt of a confirmed cancelled status via the|MeetingInstructionStatus message, a new MeetingInstruction message can be sent.|This message definition is intended for use with the Business Application Header (BAH).

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: ShortLongNumberRule
rules.text: ShortNumber must contain the FIN message type number of the linked message. LongNumber must contain the XML message identifier of the linked message.

rules.name: WithLinkageRule
rules.text: If Code WITH is used, then the one or more instruction which are linked become bound and which must be executed together. Even if one single transactions/instructions/notifications can not be executed, then all the other transactions/instructions/notifications must also be kept pending. Therefore the use of code WITH must be limited to combine up to 2 or 3 transactions/instructions/notifications.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: RightsHolderMultiplicity1Guideline
rules.text: It is recommended that RightsHolder is only present more than once if there is joint ownership.

rules.name: BalanceQall1Rule
rules.text: If SubAccountIdentification is present, then InstructedBalance/Balance/Code "QALL" (AllSecurities) is not allowed in any occurrence of InstructedBalance.

rules.name: AccountIdentificationOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: Either AccountIdentification or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.

rules.name: AccountIdentificationOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present then AccountIdentification must be absent.

rules.name: AccountIdentificationOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: If AccountIdentification is present, then BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: StructuredOrUnstructured1Guideline
rules.text: It is recommended that Structured be used.

rules.name: OtherAddressCode1Rule
rules.text: If DeliveryMethod is OtherAddress "OADR", then OtherAddress must be present.

rules.name: ProxyAppointment1Rule
rules.text: If ProxyType is DISC (Discretionary) or HLDR (SecurityHolder), then PersonDetails must be present.

rules.name: InFavourListingGroup1Rule
rules.text: If two or more occurrences of the element VoteInstruction/ListingGroupResolutionLabel have the exact same textual value, then only a single occurrence of the VoteInstruction sequence amongst these occurrences may have the element “For” (vote in favour) being present.

rules.name: MeetingAttendeeRule
rules.text: If at least one occurrence of MeetingAttendee is present, then SpecificInstructionRequest/ParticipationMethod/Code must be PHYS (InPerson).

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: PaginationRule
rules.text: If pagination is present, then MeetingInstructionIdentification must be present.

rules.name: EntitlementFixingDate1Rule
rules.text: If Confirmation of Holding Required in MeetingNotification is set to Y, then Entitlement Fixing Date must be provided.
